license.notes: Zoo 1.81.0. The corner deli's service case: a white enamel base with an accent band and a steel bumper, a black kick, curved front glass in three facets, glass end panes, a stainless top with a fluorescent tube under its front edge, sliding glass doors on the staff side over a black rail, and a lit deck -- price cards, plastic parsley, sixth pans of salads, trays of sliced meat -- with whole logs and blocks on its back half, their cut faces to the glass. Deli Counter's corner deli has stood a `deli_case_cover` since the recipe was written and no species answered to it: cold run 9189 built it as a plain glass box. Three submissions whatever the length: painted metal (colour in the Wear vertex colour; the accent band's follows the variant), glass, and the glow (deck, tube, logs and blocks on ONE backlit image, M_DeliCase_<art>_Face, Lux's power cut takes it). Every cold cut and salad is a generic word; no brand reaches the case. Collision is the slot's box.
